description: This Java class implements a cache manager that delegates cache operations to either an EhCache or a default cache manager, allowing dynamic switching between cache types and retrieving cache status information.

classes.name: RuntimeDelegatingCacheManager
classes.description: A cache manager that delegates cache operations to either an EhCache or a default cache manager, with capabilities to switch cache types and retrieve cache status.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the current cache manager to the default cache manager after properties are set.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves a cache by name from the current cache manager.

methods.name: getCacheNames
methods.description: Returns the collection of cache names from the current cache manager.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Returns cache status information for no cache and single node cache types.

methods.name: switchToCache
methods.description: Switches the active cache manager to either EhCache or default, and clears EhCache if needed.

methods.name: clearEhCache
methods.description: Clears all caches in the EhCache cache manager.
